motivation: 12B's looping thought runs to the thinking cap and the run dies of a context overflow. A neuron that reads 'a sentence was just repeated' and writes the end-of-thought token ends the thought at the loop's start.
hypothesis: The read-out separates loop sentence ends from normal sentence ends on held-out tasks (99th percentile at normal sentence ends under 0.1); the agent test measures loops, overflows and tasks solved.

config.selection_rule: max held-out pos_mean with hard-negative p99 < 0.1

env.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
